newsitem.title: USA: Noel Group stake held by Farallon group.
newsitem.headline: Noel Group stake held by Farallon group.

text.p: A group led by Farallon Capital Management LLC said Monday it holds a five percent stake in Noel Group Inc, or 1,018,500 common shares.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest transactions include the purchase of 30,000 additional common shares on December 19 at a price of $7.04 per share.
The group said it holds the stake for New York company for investment purposes.
Noel Group conducts its principal operations through small and medium sized operating companies in which with holds controlling, or other significant equity interests.
The operating companies are in the fields of thread fasteners and key distribution, snack and foods and optical sporting goods.
